solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Not working, like a monk who has defected?

definitions.meaning: a broken machine is said to be unusable or kaput

definitions.text: like a monk who has defected?
definitions.meaning: a monk who leaves has quit his religious order, so he is now outside it

explanation.definitionFit: A common idiom for a broken machine; read literally it describes someone no longer within a religious community.

clue.text: Golden sun eclipsed by black round shapes

indicators.note: eclipsed by means in this down clue the sun sits below the black letter

parts.note: or is the heraldic word for gold
B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
S is the abbreviation for sun or Sunday

explanation.surface: A golden sun hidden by darkness, imagery of celestial bodies.
explanation.walkthrough: OR is heraldic gold. In a down answer 'eclipsed by' puts S under B.
explanation.definitionFit: Orbs are spheres or globes, round shapes.

clue.text: Small image of wretched lamb in hut

indicators.note: wretched means in a sorry state, so the letters are mixed up

explanation.surface: A small picture of a miserable lamb sheltering in a shed.
explanation.definitionFit: A thumbnail is a reduced-size version of a picture, used as a preview.

clue.text: Initial opportunity for buyer flashing rare fistfuls

indicators.note: flashing means moving rapidly about, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: First chance to buy, waving around unusual handfuls of cash.
explanation.definitionFit: First refusal is the right to buy something before it is offered to anyone else.

clue.text: Need, having forfeited right to get married, some solemn music

indicators.note: having forfeited means the right letter is given up from the need word

parts.note: to need is to require

explanation.surface: A person needs to give up rights to wed, with solemn music playing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'having forfeited' drops only one of the two Rs; 'to get' is a link before M for married.
explanation.definitionFit: A requiem is a mass for the dead, a piece of solemn church music.

clue.text: Decorative piece of nasty green outside gym

indicators.note: outside means the rearranged colour goes around the gym letters
nasty means unpleasant, so the letters of the colour are disturbed

parts.note: PE is physical education, school gym

explanation.surface: A garish green ornament outside a gymnasium.
explanation.walkthrough: 'nasty' scrambles the colour to ERGNE, and 'outside' wraps that round the gym letters, splitting after its first E.
explanation.definitionFit: An epergne is an ornamental centrepiece for a dining table, a decorative item.

clue.text: Look conveying love and joy, no end

parts.note: love is nil in tennis, the letter O

indicators.note: no end means the final letter of the synonym for joy is dropped

parts.note: joy means glee

explanation.surface: A glance that carries affection and happiness, cut short.
explanation.definitionFit: To ogle is to look at someone, usually admiringly or lecherously; a verb synonym.

clue.text: What leaves will do on line? Grumble

indicators.note: on means in this down clue the line letter comes after

parts.note: leaves will grow on a plant

explanation.surface: A question about foliage on a washing line, then a complaint.
explanation.definitionFit: To growl is to complain in a low, irritable voice, a synonym of grumble.

clue.text: Perhaps Chinese organs will drown author

indicators.note: will drown means the organs word swallows up the author

parts.note: ears are organs of hearing
Laurence Sterne wrote Tristram Shandy

explanation.surface: Chinese organs could submerge a writer, a sinister scene.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Organs' looks musical but means body parts; Laurence Sterne is the eighteenth-century novelist.
explanation.definitionFit: Easterners are people from the East, of which the Chinese are an example.

clue.text: Having little internal energy pop group is less happy

indicators.note: having a little something internal means a small piece sits inside the band's name

parts.note: Blur is a British pop group of the 1990s
E is the physics symbol for energy

explanation.surface: A band low on energy is feeling down.
explanation.walkthrough: BLUR was a leading Britpop band; E for energy goes inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Blue means sad, so its comparative describes someone sadder than before.

clue.text: Search is getting on inside — things to be discussed

parts.note: a quest is a search

indicators.note: inside means the words for getting on are placed within the word is

parts.note: taken as written
getting on means on, as in carrying on with something

explanation.surface: Someone searching while ageing ponders matters for debate.
explanation.definitionFit: Questions are matters raised for debate, as in an agenda's points for discussion.

clue.text: Asian and Greek character coming into money

indicators.note: coming into means the Greek letter is put inside the money word

parts.note: tin is slang for money
beta is the second Greek letter

explanation.surface: An Asian and a Greek inherit money.
explanation.definitionFit: A Tibetan is a native of Tibet, an Asian people.

clue.text: Dish is an item left in B & B by the French female

indicators.note: left in means placed inside, so the item sits between the two Bs

parts.note: B and B, the two letters of bed and breakfast
an item means a thing
elle is the French word for she, a female

explanation.surface: A guest-house breakfast dish, with something left behind by a French woman.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Dish' is slang for an attractive person, not food. A THING goes between the two Bs, then ELLE (French for 'she') follows.
explanation.definitionFit: Slang for an attractive person; a bathing beauty is an attractive woman in swimwear at a beauty contest.

clue.text: See 12
Brought together amicably in rough hansom ride

indicators.note: rough means bumpy and disordered, so the letters are jumbled

explanation.surface: Two people reconciled during a bumpy horse-drawn cab journey.
explanation.walkthrough: A hansom is a two-wheeled horse-drawn cab.
explanation.definitionFit: Harmonised means made to agree or coexist peacefully, brought into accord.

clue.text: A horse getting hit — there's bound to be one near here!

definitions.text: there's bound to be one near here!

parts.note: a nag is an old horse
to ram is to hit hard

explanation.surface: A horse is struck, with an exclamation that one must be close by.
explanation.walkthrough: The definition points at the puzzle itself: a crossword is bound to contain letter-shuffle clues, including this one's neighbours.
explanation.definitionFit: A rearranged-letter clue is a staple of cryptic crosswords, so one is surely nearby in this grid.

clue.text: See 3
Go into leg to find part of the body

parts.note: to go into is to enter
the leg side in cricket is also called the on side

explanation.surface: Advice to enter a leg to locate an anatomical part.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket the leg side of the field is also the on side, so leg gives ON.
explanation.definitionFit: The enteron is the alimentary canal, the whole gut, an anatomical structure.

clue.text: Dissolute type mixes a beer with port

indicators.note: mixes means the letters are blended into a new order

explanation.surface: A drunkard combines a beer and port in one glass.
explanation.definitionFit: A reprobate is an unprincipled person of immoral habits, a dissolute character.

clue.text: Evil female in charge going after bloke

indicators.note: going after means the following pieces come behind the word for bloke

parts.note: a bloke is a male

explanation.surface: A wicked woman in authority chases a man.
explanation.definitionFit: Malefic is a literary adjective meaning causing harm or evil, a direct synonym.

clue.text: Government building needs pass — a very dirty place inside

indicators.note: inside means the dirty place goes within the pass word

parts.note: a col is a mountain pass
a pit is a squalid, filthy place

explanation.surface: Entry to a government building demands a pass, yet it's filthy within.
explanation.definitionFit: The Capitol in Washington houses the US Congress, a seat of government.

clue.text: Plant, one pruned primarily within particular month, right?

indicators.note: within means the next pieces are put inside the month

parts.note: June is a particular month
one is the Roman numeral I

indicators.note: primarily means the first letter of the word pruned

explanation.surface: A gardener asks whether a plant should be trimmed in a certain month.
explanation.definitionFit: The juniper is an evergreen shrub, an example of a plant.

clue.text: Sailor with lots of notes turned over as a thief?

parts.note: Jack, as in Jack tar, is a sailor

indicators.note: turned over means the notes word is read backwards

parts.note: a wad is a thick bundle of banknotes

explanation.surface: A sailor with a pile of cash flips it, looking like a crook.
explanation.definitionFit: The jackdaw is a crow famed for stealing shiny objects, so it is a thief by nature.

clue.text: Poem going in opposite directions making significant points

indicators.note: going in means the poem is placed inside the pair of directions

parts.note: north and south are opposite compass points
an ode is a lyric poem

explanation.surface: A poem pulling two ways makes important points.
explanation.definitionFit: Nodes are key junctions or points in a network or graph, crucial locations.

clue.text: Doctor in secret place becoming a Mr Hyde type?

indicators.note: in means the doctor sits inside the secret place

parts.note: a den is a hidden retreat
MO is a medical officer, a doctor

explanation.surface: A doctor in a hideaway turning into his evil alter ego.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface evokes Dr Jekyll; 'Doctor' is actually just MO, medical officer.
explanation.definitionFit: Mr Hyde is the monstrous side of Jekyll, a fiend, so this is a definition by example.

clue.text: Artist is idiot in very good company

parts.note: pi is crossword shorthand for pious, very good

indicators.note: in means the idiot sits inside the word for company

parts.note: an ass is an idiot

explanation.surface: A fool among respectable people turns out to be an artist.
explanation.walkthrough: PI (short for pious) is a crossword convention for very good.
explanation.definitionFit: Pablo Picasso was the Spanish painter, an example of an artist.

clue.text: Wonderful agent, American in the ascendant

indicators.note: in the ascendant means in this down clue the pieces read upwards

parts.note: a rep is a sales agent
US means American

explanation.surface: A brilliant American spy on the rise.
explanation.definitionFit: Super is an informal adjective meaning excellent or marvellous.

clue.text: Maiden captured by gangster's offering financial help

indicators.note: captured by means the maiden is held inside the gangster word

parts.note: Al Capone was the famous gangster, giving Al's
M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over

explanation.surface: A girl kidnapped by a mobster offers money.
explanation.walkthrough: A maiden in cricket is an over with no runs, abbreviated M.
explanation.definitionFit: Alms are charitable gifts of money to the poor, a form of monetary aid.

clue.text: A lit-up emerald's phony — it's an artificial stone

indicators.note: phony means false, so the letters are rearranged into something fake

parts.note: taken as written
taken as written, the S included

explanation.surface: A glowing emerald is a fake, just an imitation gem.
explanation.walkthrough: 'phony' signals rearranging all fourteen letters of A LIT-UP EMERALDS.
explanation.definitionFit: A simulated pearl is a man-made imitation of a natural gem from an oyster.

clue.text: See 27
European steps putting Conservative off

indicators.note: putting off means the letter is removed from the steps word

parts.note: a dance is a set of steps

explanation.surface: A European postpones a politician from his routine.
explanation.definitionFit: A Dane is a native of Denmark, a European nationality.

clue.text: Breed fowls, running around patches in the garden

indicators.note: running around means the letters are scrambled into a new order

explanation.surface: Chickens bred loose dash across the garden beds.
explanation.definitionFit: Flowerbeds are cultivated plots in a garden where flowers grow.
